input.summary: Delete the disclose-and-match gate at § 7.2 that operates as de facto exclusivity on Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the requirement to disclose and match competing offers before engaging another provider, because it operates as a de facto exclusivity and most-favoured-customer commitment on us and contradicts Section 12.3, under which we make no exclusivity or MFC commitment. If Cobalt needs some form of preference, we could consider a narrow arrangement limited to a defined service category for no more than twelve months that ends automatically on any missed service level or delivery date.
